rules: Original core.select/core.fill unchanged. TOM last cash day and first3; compression prior range<0.65 priorATR, first5m close breakout, next open to RTHclose; sweep exactly one overnight side in first30m,09:59backinside and reversal vsopen,10:00open to11:59close.

sizing.atr: Prior-known ATR14 only; missing/nonpositive -> size0, counted explicitly, no price filling.
sizing.R: ATR scale, not stop-loss or maximum loss. netNQ_R=(gross_points-1.225)/ATR.
sizing.MNQ_cost_basis: Provisional $4.50 RT commission/fees plus2ticks perleg ($2 total). Not actual broker quote. Never divide NQ fees by10.
sizing.integer: floor before entry, may be0; no minimum1 and no forced budget increase.
sizing.portfolio: Exactly1/3 each, idle capital remains idle, no netting cost credits, no fitted weights.
sizing.MNQ_limit: NQ bar execution proxy only. Fractional contracts not tradeable; MNQ launched2019May6. No margin/capital claim.

daily: All435/493 sessions, no-signal and missing-size days are0, dailyendpoint correlations; ATRready-only sensitivity separately.
risk: Closed-day cumulative drawdown plus minute-close marked drawdown; fullRT charged atentry; raw contract prices only; sqrt252 mean(dailyPnL_R)/sampleSD, not return on account capital.

inference.block: 2 consecutive calendar months, joint identical block indexes across ALL models and variants; pooled daily sums/counts.
inference.CI: Nominal95% percentile CI of meanR/day and Sharpe; totalCI=meanCI*originalN. Approximate centered-bootstrap two-sided p, not exact.
inference.family: 8 exploratory NQ_ATR dailymean tests:3models+portfolio x2sources, Holm8. Not correction for all historical research; no promotion.

future_data: No2019-21 outcome release; intake metadata allowed. Both existing datasets consumed and selected; older contract identity unverified.
